rows.speaker: Murrue
rows.en: All $c units have finished launching.
rows.display_text: 「All $c units have finished launching.」

rows.speaker: Waltfeld
rows.en: Quite a sight, even at only about half our strength. ...Though I suppose a sight like this isn't something to celebrate.
rows.display_text:
「Quite a sight, even at about half our
strength... Though I suppose it's not
something to celebrate.」

rows.speaker: Lacus
rows.en: Right now, what matters most is uncovering the truth as quickly as possible and restoring peace to the world without delay.
rows.display_text:
「What matters now is quickly uncovering
the truth and swiftly restoring world
peace.」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: That is exactly why this power was gathered. Our mission is to use it correctly.
rows.display_text:
「That is exactly why this power was
gathered. Our mission is to use it
correctly.」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: All units, prepare to intercept! Here they come!
rows.display_text:
「All units, prepare to intercept! Here
they come!」

rows.speaker: Fa
rows.en: What is this squadron...!?
rows.display_text: 「What is this squadron...!?」

rows.speaker: Pala
rows.en: Mechs from all sorts of organizations are attacking together!
rows.display_text:
「Mechs from all sorts of organizations
are attacking together!」

rows.speaker: Gavane
rows.en: So those are the unmanned unit forces we heard about!
rows.display_text:
「So those are the unmanned unit forces
we heard about!」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: (The Turn A is reacting...!? I knew it -- it's connected to that unmanned unit's system...!)
rows.display_text:
（(The Turn A is reacting...!? I knew it
-- it's connected to that unmanned unit's
system...!)）

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: (If no one had been aboard, would it have gone berserk again...)
rows.display_text:
（(If no one had been aboard, would it
have gone berserk again...)）

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: The Turn A is reacting...!? I knew it -- that unmanned unit's system is connected to this...!
rows.display_text:
「The Turn A is reacting...!? I knew it
-- that unmanned unit's system is
connected to this...!」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: What do you mean, Loran...!?
rows.display_text: 「What do you mean, Loran...!?」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: It seems the Turn A's rampage the other day is connected to that unmanned unit's system!
rows.display_text:
「It seems the Turn A's rampage the
other day is connected to that unmanned
unit's system!」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: Everyone piloting, please be careful! If you release control, I think it'll be taken over by them!
rows.display_text:
「Everyone piloting, be careful! If you
release control, I think they'll take it
over!」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: The White Doll launched on its own!?
rows.display_text: 「The White Doll launched on its own!?」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: It's reacting to something...!? I knew it -- that unmanned unit's system is connected to this...!
rows.display_text:
「It's reacting to something...!? I knew it
-- that unmanned unit's system is
connected to this...!」

rows.speaker: Joseph
rows.en: At this rate, it'll use the Moonlight Butterfly on its own again!
rows.display_text:
「At this rate, it'll use the Moonlight
Butterfly on its own again!」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: There's no choice...! Stop the White Doll's movement!
rows.display_text:
「There's no choice...! Stop the White
Doll's movement!」

rows.speaker: Miashei
rows.en: The White Doll...!
rows.display_text: 「The White Doll...!」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: If only I had been piloting it, this wouldn't have happened...
rows.display_text:
「If only I had been piloting it, this
wouldn't have happened...」

rows.speaker: Harry
rows.en: The Turn A can be repaired. Right now, focus on the enemy in front of us.
rows.display_text:
「The Turn A can be repaired. Right now,
focus on the enemy in front of us.」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: All units, intercept the unmanned unit swarm! Shoot them down and gather whatever information we can!
rows.display_text:
「All units, intercept the unmanned swarm!
Shoot them down and gather what info we
can!」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: Reports from the fighting all over the world confirm the enemy has considerable combat strength.
rows.display_text:
「Reports from fighting worldwide confirm
the enemy has considerable combat
strength.」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: Don't let your guard down just because they're unmanned.
rows.display_text:
「Don't let your guard down just because
they're unmanned.」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: Understood...!
rows.display_text: 「Understood...!」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: I won't let the likes of them do as they please with this world!
rows.display_text:
「I won't let the likes of them do as
they please with this world!」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: $c, begin the attack...! Strike down the ghosts of the Black History and restore peace to the world!
rows.display_text:
「$c, attack...! Strike down the Black
History's ghosts and restore peace to the
world!」

rows.speaker: Saegusa
rows.en: Confirmed -- the enemy force has been wiped out.
rows.display_text:
「Confirmed -- the enemy force has been
wiped out.」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: Any bio-signs in the area? There might be someone controlling the unmanned units.
rows.display_text:
「Any bio-signs in the area? There might
be someone controlling the unmanned units.」

rows.speaker: Torres
rows.en: We couldn't confirm anything like that.
rows.display_text: 「We couldn't confirm anything like that.」

rows.speaker: Murrue
rows.en: So they really are acting autonomously, rather than being controlled by someone.
rows.display_text:
「So they really are acting autonomously,
rather than being controlled by someone.」

rows.speaker: Waltfeld
rows.en: But setting the combat aside, someone may well have set their attack targets.
rows.display_text:
「But setting the combat aside, someone
may well have set their attack targets.」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: Then why did the unmanned unit swarm attack the base where we are?
rows.display_text:
「Then why did the unmanned unit swarm
attack the base where we are?」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: There's no Mountain Cycle anywhere near this base.
rows.display_text:
「There's no Mountain Cycle anywhere near
this base.」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: So this wasn't just a chance encounter after waking from the ruins -- there was some kind of intent behind it...
rows.display_text:
「So this wasn't a chance encounter
after waking from the ruins -- there was
some intent behind it...」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: What's wrong, Loran?
rows.display_text: 「What's wrong, Loran?」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: I think that unmanned unit was targeting the Turn A.
rows.display_text:
「I think that unmanned unit was
targeting the Turn A.」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: What do you mean...?
rows.display_text: 「What do you mean...?」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: Probably to draw the Turn A over to their side...
rows.display_text:
「Probably to draw the Turn A over to
their side...」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: So their goal is the Moonlight Butterfly System...
rows.display_text:
「So their goal is the Moonlight Butterfly
System...」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: That would explain the rampage at Vicinity that Loran reported too...
rows.display_text:
「That would explain the rampage at
Vicinity that Loran reported too...」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: (Turn A... what exactly are you? In the age of the Black History... what happened to you...)
rows.display_text:
（(Turn A... what exactly are you? In
the age of the Black History... what
happened to you...)）

rows.speaker: Meyrin
rows.en: Captain... there's a unit approaching us.
rows.display_text: 「Captain... there's a unit approaching us.」

rows.speaker: Waltfeld
rows.en: A new enemy...!?
rows.display_text: 「A new enemy...!?」

rows.speaker: Tiffa
rows.en: No. This is...
rows.display_text: 「No. This is...」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: Daitarn 3 and the Big O! And the Assault Aquarion!
rows.display_text:
「Daitarn 3 and the Big O! And the
Assault Aquarion!」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: Heh... long time no see, you guys.
rows.display_text: 「Heh... long time no see, you guys.」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: Apollo's piloting the Assault Aquarion?
rows.display_text: 「Apollo's piloting the Assault Aquarion?」

rows.speaker: Pierre
rows.en: No... these two are just tagging along.
rows.display_text: 「No... these two are just tagging along.」

rows.speaker: Silvia
rows.en: Aquarion was lost in the Spacetime Restoration, after all.
rows.display_text:
「Aquarion was lost in the Spacetime
Restoration, after all.」

rows.speaker: Sirius
rows.en: Unfortunately, DEAVA's combat strength is down to just the one Assault unit now.
rows.display_text:
「Unfortunately, DEAVA's combat strength
is down to just the one Assault unit now.」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: But we're still in this fight. We can't let anyone trash the world we all worked so hard to protect.
rows.display_text:
「But we're still in this. We can't let
anyone trash the world we worked so hard
to protect.」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: Guess some things never change -- still a wild child, huh.
rows.display_text:
「Guess some things never change -- still
a wild child, huh.」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: Banjo... if you've joined us, does that mean you've learned something about the mysterious enemy?
rows.display_text:
「Banjo... if you've joined us, did you
learn something about the mysterious
enemy?」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: We've grasped at least a fragment of it.
rows.display_text:
「We've grasped at least a fragment of
it.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Let's rendezvous with the Gallia group first. We'll go into detail there.
rows.display_text:
「Let's rendezvous with the Gallia group
first. We'll go into detail there.」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: But with no idea how the enemy will move, it's dangerous to shift our forces carelessly.
rows.display_text:
「But with no idea how the enemy will
move, it's dangerous to shift our forces
carelessly.」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: No... we've located the enemy's stronghold. We can rendezvous with the Gallia group on the way there.
rows.display_text:
「No... we've found the enemy's
stronghold. We can rendezvous with the
Gallia group en route.」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: The enemy's stronghold... where is it?
rows.display_text: 「The enemy's stronghold... where is it?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: The land of the rising sun... A place called Yapan.
rows.display_text:
「The land of the rising sun... A place
called Yapan.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Yapan... Japan...
rows.display_text: 「Yapan... Japan...」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: This peace was won on the sacrifice of countless people...! I will protect it, no matter what!
rows.display_text:
「This peace cost countless lives...! I will
protect it, no matter what!」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: Anyone who wants war has no place left in this world!
rows.display_text:
「Anyone who wants war has no place left
in this world!」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: What's the point of a scheme this elaborate...?
rows.display_text:
「What's the point of a scheme this
elaborate...?」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: What could they possibly gain from a show of force like this...!?
rows.display_text:
「What could they possibly gain from a
show of force like this...!?」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: There's nothing more unsettling than an enemy whose intentions you can't read...!
rows.display_text:
「There's nothing more unsettling than an
enemy whose intentions you can't read...!」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: An enemy wielding relics of the Black History... just who are they...!?
rows.display_text:
「An enemy wielding relics of the Black
History... just who are they...!?」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: Does the Turn A have the same system as these unmanned units too...?
rows.display_text:
「Does the Turn A have the same system
as these unmanned units too...?」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: Why in the world would people from the age of the Black History have built in a system like that...!?
rows.display_text:
「Why would people from the Black History
era have built in a system like that...!?」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: Whoever it is, if they want a war, I'll be their opponent...!
rows.display_text:
「Whoever it is, if they want a war, I'll
be their opponent...!」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: This is the peace we finally won! Are you telling me you don't understand how much that's worth?!
rows.display_text:
「This is the peace we finally won! Are
you telling me you don't understand how
much that's worth?!」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: No matter how many times they're blown away, I'll keep planting flowers...
rows.display_text:
「No matter how many times they're blown
away, I'll keep planting flowers...」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: If someone appears to steal our peace, I won't hesitate to fight anymore...! I have the resolve to fight too!
rows.display_text:
「If someone appears to steal our peace,
I won't hesitate to fight anymore...! I
have the resolve to fight too!」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: Just as Tiffa lends me her strength, I want to do something for the world too...!
rows.display_text:
「Just as Tiffa lends me her strength, I
want to do something for the world too...!」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: If someone comes to destroy a world where everyone can live and laugh, I'll be the one to face them!!
rows.display_text:
「If someone comes to destroy a world
where all can live and laugh, I'll face
them!!」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: Humanity is trying to move past its mistakes and step into the future...!
rows.display_text:
「Humanity is trying to move past its
mistakes and step into the future...!」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: If anyone appears to stand in the way of that, I won't hesitate to pull the trigger!
rows.display_text:
「If anyone appears to stand in the way
of that, I won't hesitate to pull the
trigger!」

rows.speaker: Toby
rows.en: $n! We've got your back! Push forward!
rows.display_text: 「$n! We've got your back! Push forward!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Toby...
rows.display_text: 「Toby...」

rows.speaker: Denzel
rows.en: You're the ace of Glory Star...! I'm entrusting you with the pride of that glorious star!
rows.display_text:
「You're the ace of Glory Star...! I'm
entrusting you with the pride of that
glorious star!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Understood, Chief...!
rows.display_text: 「Understood, Chief...!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: I'm not alone...! For the people who taught me that, and for their world...
rows.display_text:
「I'm not alone...! For the people who
taught me that, and for their world...」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: I will fight...! With duty and pride in my heart!!
rows.display_text:
「I will fight...! With duty and pride in
my heart!!」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: Thank you all for gathering here. I appreciate your cooperation.
rows.display_text:
「Thank you all for gathering here. I
appreciate your cooperation.」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: No need for thanks, Lt. Quattro. This is a crisis for the whole world.
rows.display_text:
「No need for thanks, Lt. Quattro. This
is a crisis for the whole world.」

rows.speaker: Roybea
rows.en: ...Oh wait, aren't you not a Lieutenant anymore?
rows.display_text:
「...Oh wait, aren't you not a Lieutenant
anymore?」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: It's fine. The New Earth Federation Forces still haven't sorted themselves out internally after the war.
rows.display_text:
「It's fine. The New Earth Federation
Forces still haven't sorted things out
internally since the war.」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: Even matters like the treatment of former AEUG personnel -- myself and Captain Bright included -- are still up in the air.
rows.display_text:
「Even our treatment as ex-AEUG members
-- myself, Capt. Bright included -- is
still unsettled.」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: That's why, for this particular incident, a unit that crosses organizational lines was called for, and we were the ones chosen.
rows.display_text:
「That's why this incident called for a
cross-organization unit, and we were
chosen.」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: A gathering of people beyond any organization or nation, a unit that can respond to any enemy...
rows.display_text:
「A gathering beyond any organization or
nation, a unit that can respond to any
enemy...」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: That really does describe $c perfectly.
rows.display_text:
「That really does describe $c
perfectly.」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: So... how much do we actually know about that unmanned unit attack?
rows.display_text:
「So... how much do we actually know
about that unmanned unit attack?」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: We don't have exact figures on the damage yet, but...
rows.display_text:
「We don't have exact figures on the
damage yet, but...」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: It was mostly destruction of facilities -- casualties were apparently very minimal.
rows.display_text:
「It was mostly destruction of facilities
-- casualties were apparently very
minimal.」

rows.speaker: Lunamaria
rows.en: Even after an attack that massive...!?
rows.display_text: 「Even after an attack that massive...!?」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: This attack was most likely some kind of show of force.
rows.display_text:
「This attack was most likely some kind
of show of force.」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: A demonstration meant to flaunt their strength...
rows.display_text:
「A demonstration meant to flaunt their
strength...」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: And it's had an enormous effect. After all, the unmanned units' attacks reached every corner of the atmosphere.
rows.display_text:
「And the effect's huge. The unmanned
units' attacks reached every corner of
the atmosphere.」

rows.speaker: Mu
rows.en: What I don't get is the areas that got hit... The pattern's all over the place.
rows.display_text:
「What I don't get is the areas that got
hit... The pattern's all over the place.」

rows.speaker: Lancerow
rows.en: Hmm... it doesn't look like densely populated areas or military facilities were specifically targeted.
rows.display_text:
「Hmm... densely populated areas and
military facilities don't seem to have
been specifically targeted.」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: On that point, I'd like you to refer to a matter the New Federation Forces have been investigating since the previous war.
rows.display_text:
「On that, please refer to a matter the
New Federation Forces have investigated
since the last war.」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: First, please take a look at this.
rows.display_text: 「First, please take a look at this.」

rows.speaker: Murrue
rows.en: This is... a map of the current multiverse, isn't it? What do the marks all over it mean?
rows.display_text:
「This is... a map of the current
multiverse, isn't it? What do the marks
all over it mean?」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: Those are the locations targeted in this attack.
rows.display_text:
「Those are the locations targeted in
this attack.」

rows.speaker: Yzak
rows.en: Seeing it on a map like this really shows how the whole world was targeted at once.
rows.display_text:
「Seeing it on a map like this really
shows how the whole world was targeted
at once.」

rows.speaker: Waltfeld
rows.en: Still... deploying forces across the entire world takes some incredible organizational power.
rows.display_text:
「Still... deploying forces across the
entire world takes some incredible
organizational power.」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: I'll overlay this damage map with the New Federation Forces' data I mentioned earlier.
rows.display_text:
「I'll overlay this damage map with the
New Federation Forces' data I mentioned
earlier.」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: The marks line up almost perfectly...
rows.display_text: 「The marks line up almost perfectly...」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: That's right. There's been some change in terrain from the Spacetime Restoration, but the two match up almost exactly.
rows.display_text:
「That's right. Terrain has shifted some
from the Spacetime Restoration, but the
two match almost exactly.」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: What exactly was the Federation investigating? What was at the places that got hit?
rows.display_text:
「What exactly was the Federation
investigating? What was at the places
that got hit?」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: What the New Federation Forces were investigating were sites believed to be Black History ruins.
rows.display_text:
「What the New Federation Forces were
investigating were sites believed to be
Black History ruins.」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: What...!
rows.display_text: 「What...!」

rows.speaker: Joseph
rows.en: You mean a Mountain Cycle...
rows.display_text: 「You mean a Mountain Cycle...」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: That's right. This attack occurred near locations believed to be Mountain Cycles.
rows.display_text:
「That's right. This attack occurred near
locations believed to be Mountain Cycles.」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: So the enemy was after the Black History ruins?
rows.display_text:
「So the enemy was after the Black
History ruins?」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: That doesn't seem to be the case.
rows.display_text: 「That doesn't seem to be the case.」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: Piecing together the few eyewitness accounts we have, it seems the unmanned units that attacked the cities emerged from the Black History ruins.
rows.display_text:
「The few eyewitness accounts suggest
the unmanned units hitting cities came
from the Black History ruins.」

rows.speaker: Pala
rows.en: Huh!?
rows.display_text: 「Huh!?」

rows.speaker: Witz
rows.en: For real...? That's...
rows.display_text: 「For real...? That's...」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: But if that's true, it would explain the reckless strategy of deploying forces all over the world at once.
rows.display_text:
「If true, that'd explain the reckless
strategy of deploying forces worldwide at
once.」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: Right. Whoever orchestrated this didn't dispatch forces to locations all over the world...
rows.display_text:
「Right. Whoever orchestrated this didn't
dispatch forces to locations all over the
world...」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: They awakened the Black History relics sleeping in each of those places and had them attack the surrounding area.
rows.display_text:
「They woke the Black History relics
sleeping there and had them attack the
area.」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: But who could even do something like that...? How did they activate unmanned units sleeping in the ruins...!?
rows.display_text:
「But who could do something like that...?
How did they activate unmanned units
sleeping in the ruins...!?」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: And for what purpose, exactly...!?
rows.display_text: 「And for what purpose, exactly...!?」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: Calm down, Shinn. That's probably exactly why we were called in -- to find out.
rows.display_text:
「Calm down, Shinn. That's probably
exactly why we were called in -- to find
out.」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: That's right. We understand the enemy's movements, but their identity and purpose remain unknown.
rows.display_text:
「That's right. We understand the enemy's
movements, but their identity and purpose
stay unknown.」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: On top of that, we've lost track of the unmanned unit swarm that withdrew.
rows.display_text:
「On top of that, we've lost track of
the unmanned unit swarm that withdrew.」

rows.speaker: Carris
rows.en: Being unmanned, once you lose track of them, finding them again will be difficult.
rows.display_text:
「Being unmanned, once you lose track of
them, finding them again will be difficult.」

rows.speaker: Katz
rows.en: There's so much we don't know... I have no idea where to even start.
rows.display_text:
「There's so much we don't know... I have
no idea where to even start.」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: The one clue we have lies in the unmanned units themselves.
rows.display_text:
「The one clue we have lies in the
unmanned units themselves.」

rows.speaker: Ennil
rows.en: For relics of the Black History, there sure were a lot of different types.
rows.display_text:
「For relics of the Black History, there
sure were a lot of different types.」

rows.speaker: Roybea
rows.en: And they belonged to all the various organizations we've fought.
rows.display_text:
「And they belonged to all the various
organizations we've fought.」

rows.speaker: Roybea
rows.en: This makes it feel real that some $c's fight, somewhere, that we saw at D.O.M.E., is what set off the Black History.
rows.display_text:
「Makes it feel real that some $c's
fight we saw at D.O.M.E. is what set off
the Black History.」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: But that swarm of unmanned units does share one thing in common -- the control system in their frames.
rows.display_text:
「But that swarm of unmanned units
shares one thing -- the control system
in their frames.」

rows.speaker: Emma
rows.en: A control system...? Something like an autopilot function?
rows.display_text:
「A control system...? Something like an
autopilot function?」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: That's right. The unmanned units aren't operating under outside control -- they're running on an autonomous system.
rows.display_text:
「That's right. The unmanned units aren't
outside-controlled -- they run on an
autonomous system.」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: And analysis of the wreckage from the ones we shot down revealed that every single unit is equipped with the same system.
rows.display_text:
「Wreckage analysis showed every unit we
downed carries the same system.」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: Then...
rows.display_text: 「Then...」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: The mastermind most likely used some method to activate every unit's system simultaneously.
rows.display_text:
「The mastermind most likely used some
method to activate every unit's system
simultaneously.」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: And that's what attacked the cities...!
rows.display_text: 「And that's what attacked the cities...!」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: We're still investigating the exact mechanism, but one word kept coming up while we were analyzing the system.
rows.display_text:
「We're still investigating the mechanism,
but one word kept coming up while
analyzing the system.」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: Executor... We believe that's likely the system's name.
rows.display_text:
「Executor... We believe that's likely the
system's name.」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: The Executor... System.
rows.display_text: 「The Executor... System.」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: An enforcer... huh.
rows.display_text: 「An enforcer... huh.」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: (Is that why the Turn A started moving on its own too -- because it has that system installed...?)
rows.display_text:
（(Is that why the Turn A started
moving on its own too -- because it has
that system installed...?)）

rows.speaker: Toniya
rows.en: But why would a system like that be buried in the ruins...?
rows.display_text:
「But why would a system like that be
buried in the ruins...?」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: That part remains a complete mystery. There's no precedent for anything similar.
rows.display_text:
「That part remains a complete mystery.
There's no precedent for anything similar.」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: The Black History... Is it going to cast its shadow over the world again?
rows.display_text:
「The Black History... Is it going to cast
its shadow over the world again?」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: With D.O.M.E. now asleep, there's no way to confirm what really happened back then.
rows.display_text:
「With D.O.M.E. now asleep, there's no way
to confirm what really happened back
then.」

rows.speaker: Mu
rows.en: So there's simply no way to investigate the true nature of the Executor System.
rows.display_text:
「So there's simply no way to investigate
the true nature of the Executor System.」

rows.speaker: Lacus
rows.en: Getting to the truth of this matters, but let's focus first on protecting people.
rows.display_text:
「Getting to the truth of this matters,
but let's focus first on protecting
people.」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: For now, we'll track the unmanned unit swarm, and if another attack occurs, we'll work with local forces to intercept them.
rows.display_text:
「For now, we'll track the unmanned
swarm; if they attack again, we'll
intercept with local forces.」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: Damn it... $c's been reformed and we still don't have a move to make...!
rows.display_text:
「Damn it... $c's been reformed and we
still don't have a move to make...!」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: Shinn...
rows.display_text: 「Shinn...」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: Calm down. Us getting worked up won't change anything.
rows.display_text:
「Calm down. Us getting worked up won't
change anything.」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: I know. But... I want to do something about it.
rows.display_text:
「I know. But... I want to do something
about it.」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: So much happened in the last war... I met all kinds of people, and said goodbye to them too...
rows.display_text:
「So much happened in the last war... I
met all kinds of people, and said goodbye
to them too...」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: I swore to those people that I'd build a future for them...
rows.display_text:
「I swore to those people that I'd build
a future for them...」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: Everyone... is just like you.
rows.display_text: 「Everyone... is just like you.」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: I know, Shinn. All of us feel exactly the same way.
rows.display_text:
「I know, Shinn. All of us feel exactly
the same way.」

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: I found a reason to live too, after meeting Kamille.
rows.display_text:
「I found a reason to live too, after
meeting Kamille.」

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: That's why I want to fight. I don't want to watch any more lives get taken away.
rows.display_text:
「That's why I want to fight. I don't
want to watch any more lives get taken
away.」

rows.speaker: Fa
rows.en: Four...
rows.display_text: 「Four...」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: Everyone here feels the same way -- that's why we're here, carrying the feelings of so many people.
rows.display_text:
「Everyone here feels the same -- that's
why we're here, carrying so many people's
feelings.」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: Yeah...!
rows.display_text: 「Yeah...!」

rows.speaker: Lacus
rows.en: For the sake of those who fought with their lives on the line, believing in tomorrow, we must protect the future.
rows.display_text:
「For those who fought with their lives
on the line, believing in tomorrow, we
must protect the future.」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: Let's fight for this world, and for everyone living in it.
rows.display_text:
「Let's fight for this world, and for
everyone living in it.」

rows.speaker: Corin
rows.en: Lady Dianna...! We've just arrived from the Moon.
rows.display_text:
「Lady Dianna...! We've just arrived from
the Moon.」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: Corin Nander, thank you for coming.
rows.display_text: 「Corin Nander, thank you for coming.」

rows.speaker: Harry
rows.en: Harry Ord, Corin Nander, Poe Aijee... joining $c.
rows.display_text:
「Harry Ord, Corin Nander, Poe Aijee...
joining $c.」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: Well done, Harry. And...
rows.display_text: 「Well done, Harry. And...」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: Sister!
rows.display_text: 「Sister!」

rows.speaker: Kihel
rows.en: Sochie... I'm glad you're safe.
rows.display_text: 「Sochie... I'm glad you're safe.」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: I've been waiting for you, Kihel Heim.
rows.display_text: 「I've been waiting for you, Kihel Heim.」

rows.speaker: Kihel
rows.en: Lady Dianna, I've brought the Soleil.
rows.display_text: 「Lady Dianna, I've brought the Soleil.」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: Thank you. For a short while, allow me to become Dianna again.
rows.display_text:
「Thank you. For a short while, allow me
to become Dianna again.」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: But if anything should happen to me, then I would ask you to take the seat of Dianna...
rows.display_text:
「But if anything should happen to me,
then I would ask you to take the seat of
Dianna...」

rows.speaker: Harry
rows.en: Lady Dianna...
rows.display_text: 「Lady Dianna...」

rows.speaker: Kihel
rows.en: Please, don't think such ominous thoughts.
rows.display_text:
「Please, don't think such ominous
thoughts.」

rows.speaker: Kihel
rows.en: Please fight to live. If you're fighting to protect the world, then your own life matters just as much.
rows.display_text:
「Please fight to live. If you fight to
protect the world, your own life matters
just as much.」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: Kihel Heim, you always teach me something.
rows.display_text:
「Kihel Heim, you always teach me
something.」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: Very well, then... I go into this battle as Dianna.
rows.display_text:
「Very well, then... I go into this battle
as Dianna.」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: Once this battle is over, please allow me to live as an Earthling for just a little longer.
rows.display_text:
「Once this battle is over, please allow
me to live as an Earthling for just a
little longer.」

rows.speaker: Kihel
rows.en: Understood, Lady Dianna. I'll be waiting for your safe return.
rows.display_text:
「Understood, Lady Dianna. I'll be waiting
for your safe return.」

rows.speaker: Kihel
rows.en: Captain Harry... please fulfill your duty as Captain of the Royal Guard.
rows.display_text:
「Captain Harry... please fulfill your duty
as Captain of the Royal Guard.」

rows.speaker: Harry
rows.en: Understood. I will protect Lady Dianna, no matter what.
rows.display_text:
「Understood. I will protect Lady Dianna,
no matter what.」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: I'm counting on you, Harry.
rows.display_text: 「I'm counting on you, Harry.」

rows.speaker: Denzel
rows.en: So this is $c...
rows.display_text: 「So this is $c...」

rows.speaker: Toby
rows.en: Battle-hardened warriors bound together by trust, huh. Every last one of them's got quite the look on their face.
rows.display_text:
「Battle-hardened warriors bound by
trust, huh. Every one of them's got quite
the look on their face.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Yes... Everyone here carries a sense of duty and pride.
rows.display_text:
「Yes... Everyone here carries a sense of
duty and pride.」

rows.speaker: Toby
rows.en: You sure it's alright for half-baked outfits like us to mix into such a glorious unit, $l?
rows.display_text:
「You sure it's alright for half-baked
outfits like us to mix into such a
glorious unit, $l?」

rows.speaker: Denzel
rows.en: Cut that talk out, Toby. Whatever the circumstances, we're a team now.
rows.display_text:
「Cut that talk out, Toby. Whatever the
circumstances, we're a team now.」

rows.speaker: Toby
rows.en: That's what you say, Chief, but we're stand-ins.
rows.display_text:
「That's what you say, Chief, but we're
stand-ins.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Stand-ins...?
rows.display_text: 「Stand-ins...?」

rows.speaker: Toby
rows.en: Isn't that right, $l? Your world's Glory Star and the two of us...
rows.display_text:
「Isn't that right, $l? Your world's
Glory Star and the two of us...」

rows.speaker: Toby
rows.en: Sure, we might be the same people from a parallel world, but that doesn't mean we appreciate having a character made up for us without our say.
rows.display_text:
「Sure, we might be the same people from
a parallel world, but we won't stand for
an invented character without asking.」

rows.speaker: Toby
rows.en: Since we're at it, I'll say this straight. I'm Toby Watson. Not your Toby.
rows.display_text:
「Since we're at it, I'll say this
straight. I'm Toby Watson. Not your Toby.」

rows.speaker: Toby
rows.en: I'm the massive idiot who got tricked by some rotten scumbag and tried to kill you.
rows.display_text:
「I'm the massive idiot who got tricked
by some rotten scumbag and tried to kill
you.」

rows.speaker: Toby
rows.en: Don't forget that. I'll do what needs doing because it's the mission, but...
rows.display_text:
「Don't forget that. I'll do what needs
doing because it's the mission, but...」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Yes!
rows.display_text: 「Yes!」

rows.speaker: Toby
rows.en: Huh...?

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: It's a pleasure, Mr. Watson. This will be our first time coordinating in real combat, but I'll do my very best.
rows.display_text:
「It's a pleasure, Mr. Watson. This is our
first time coordinating in real combat,
but I'll do my best.」

rows.speaker: Toby
rows.en: You... did a screw come loose in your head or something?
rows.display_text:
「You... did a screw come loose in your
head or something?」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: That's not it. I was just a little happy, that's all.
rows.display_text:
「That's not it. I was just a little
happy, that's all.」

rows.speaker: Denzel
rows.en: Happy...? You were?
rows.display_text: 「Happy...? You were?」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Just like you said, Mr. Watson -- you two are different people from the Chief and Toby I know.
rows.display_text:
「Just like you said, Mr. Watson -- you
two are different people from the Chief
and Toby I know.」

rows.speaker: Toby
rows.en: If you know that, don't drag us into some pointless sentimentality.
rows.display_text:
「If you know that, don't drag us into
some pointless sentimentality.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: But there's one thing that doesn't change between our Glory Star and yours.
rows.display_text:
「But there's one thing that doesn't
change between our Glory Star and yours.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: It's that you take pride in the right qualities only you yourselves possess.
rows.display_text:
「It's that you take pride in the right
qualities only you yourselves possess.」

rows.speaker: Denzel
rows.en: The Right Stuff, huh...
rows.display_text: 「The Right Stuff, huh...」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: I could tell right away when we fought each other -- that you both took pride in the Virgola.
rows.display_text:
「I could tell right away when we fought
each other -- that you both took pride
in the Virgola.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: That's why, back then... I hesitated to fight you.
rows.display_text:
「That's why, back then... I hesitated to
fight you.」

rows.speaker: Toby
rows.en: Easy for you to say, after you shot us down.
rows.display_text:
「Easy for you to say, after you shot us
down.」

rows.speaker: Denzel
rows.en: Knock it off, Toby. ...The Ensign didn't do it because they wanted to, either. They were just fighting based on what they believed they had to do.
rows.display_text:
「Knock it off, Toby. The Ensign didn't
do it by choice either -- they fought
for what they felt they had to do.」

rows.speaker: Denzel
rows.en: $l. I know full well that you possess a quality that's yours and yours alone.
rows.display_text:
「$l. I know full well that you possess
a quality that's yours and yours alone.」

rows.speaker: Denzel
rows.en: Toby too, of course.
rows.display_text: 「Toby too, of course.」

rows.speaker: Toby
rows.en: H-hold on, Chief!
rows.display_text: 「H-hold on, Chief!」

rows.speaker: Denzel
rows.en: I just don't much like the idea of being someone's stand-in, that's all.
rows.display_text:
「I just don't much like the idea of
being someone's stand-in, that's all.」

rows.speaker: Denzel
rows.en: Well... I've decided not to let that bother me anymore, though.
rows.display_text:
「Well... I've decided not to let that
bother me anymore, though.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: That's not it...
rows.display_text: 「That's not it...」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: I don't think anyone is a stand-in for anyone else.
rows.display_text:
「I don't think anyone is a stand-in for
anyone else.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: ...In the last war, I learned a great many things, alongside a lot of grief.
rows.display_text:
「...In the last war, I learned a great
many things, alongside a lot of grief.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: That what's lost never comes back... That clinging to it keeps you from moving forward...
rows.display_text:
「That what's lost never comes back...
That clinging to it keeps you from moving
forward...」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: But also, that you're able to create something new.
rows.display_text:
「But also, that you're able to create
something new.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: That's why I believe -- that we, who share the same pride, can create something new together.
rows.display_text:
「That's why I believe -- that we, who
share the same pride, can create
something new together.」

rows.speaker: Denzel
rows.en: So that's the Glory Star for the three of us.
rows.display_text:
「So that's the Glory Star for the three
of us.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Yes.
rows.display_text: 「Yes.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: During the Spacetime Restoration, I made a wish -- to go on living with the duty and pride that the people important to me taught me.
rows.display_text:
「During the Spacetime Restoration, I
wished to live with the duty and pride
those important to me taught me.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: The mission to complete the Virgola no longer means anything, but...
rows.display_text:
「The mission to complete the Virgola no
longer means anything, but...」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: That machine is full of the feelings of each of us, and of the people who supported us.
rows.display_text:
「That machine is full of the feelings of
each of us, and of the people who
supported us.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: That's why I want to live proudly alongside that Virgola, while searching for something new.
rows.display_text:
「That's why I want to live proudly
alongside that Virgola, while searching for
something new.」

rows.speaker: Toby
rows.en: Real sentimental, aren't you...
rows.display_text: 「Real sentimental, aren't you...」

rows.speaker: Toby
rows.en: But I don't hate it.
rows.display_text: 「But I don't hate it.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Mr. Watson...
rows.display_text: 「Mr. Watson...」

rows.speaker: Denzel
rows.en: Geez, what a stubborn guy. I've thought highly of $l from the very start.
rows.display_text:
「Geez, what a stubborn guy. I've thought
highly of $l from the very start.」

rows.speaker: Denzel
rows.en: No, maybe I should call it affection...
rows.display_text: 「No, maybe I should call it affection...」

rows.speaker: Denzel
rows.en: No, it's not 'like'...! This is love!
rows.display_text: 「No, it's not 'like'...! This is love!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Um... that is...
rows.display_text: 「Um... that is...」

rows.speaker: Toby
rows.en: You're freaking them out, Chief. That kind of joke doesn't seem to land with $l.
rows.display_text:
「You're freaking them out, Chief. That
kind of joke doesn't seem to land with
$l.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: N-no... Mr. Watson, that's not...
rows.display_text: 「N-no... Mr. Watson, that's not...」

rows.speaker: Toby
rows.en: What a pain you are. We're a team, and you're still being all formal like that?
rows.display_text:
「What a pain you are. We're a team, and
you're still being all formal like that?」

rows.speaker: Toby
rows.en: Just call me Toby.
rows.display_text: 「Just call me Toby.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Then please call me $n too.
rows.display_text: 「Then please call me $n too.」

rows.speaker: Denzel
rows.en: Alright... from this moment on, the new Glory Star is up and running.
rows.display_text:
「Alright... from this moment on, the new
Glory Star is up and running.」

rows.speaker: Denzel
rows.en: I'd like to toast with a cold beer, but this is an emergency... As Chief, I'll be the one calling the shots.
rows.display_text:
「I'd like to toast with a cold beer, but
this is an emergency... As Chief, I'll call
the shots.」

rows.speaker: Denzel
rows.en: Attention!
rows.display_text: 「Attention!」

rows.speaker: Toby
rows.en: Sir! Yes, sir!
rows.display_text: 「Sir! Yes, sir!」

rows.speaker: Denzel
rows.en: From here on, we of Glory Star will pursue the unidentified enemy as members of $c!
rows.display_text:
「From here on, we of Glory Star will
pursue the unidentified enemy as members
of $c!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Sir! Yes, sir!
rows.display_text: 「Sir! Yes, sir!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: This alarm...! Unidentified units are approaching!
rows.display_text:
「This alarm...! Unidentified units are
approaching!」

rows.speaker: Toby
rows.en: Perfect timing for an enemy attack...! Looks like this restart's off to a stormy start!
rows.display_text:
「Perfect timing for an enemy attack...!
Looks like this restart's off to a stormy
start!」

rows.speaker: Denzel
rows.en: Let's move, Toby, $n! Scramble!
rows.display_text: 「Let's move, Toby, $n! Scramble!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Understood!
rows.display_text: 「Understood!」
